I send my follow-up within one hour after the meeting, when everything is still fresh. The first line is always a short recap: the main decision of the meeting. Then I report what people said and what they asked for. For example: Daniel said that the list was almost ready, and the partner asked us to send the logo by Monday. I also highlight any concern, in one sentence. At the end, I list the next steps, and I attach the documents. And the last line is always the same: if you understood something differently, please reply and let me know. That line has saved me from many problems.

We had a meeting with an important client yesterday, and I want to tell you what she said. First, she told us that she liked the proposal very much. But she said that the price was too high for this year. She asked us to send a new version with two options, a smaller package and a bigger one. She also pointed out a concern. She said that her company was changing its budget rules, and that the new rules would start in January. So we have to send the new proposal before December. I told her that we would send it by next Friday.
